description: Find businesses in the 2GIS directory by search term, city, point or map area, or read specific search, place, organization and building links. No account, API key or proxy is needed.

bbox.description: Optional rectangle as lon1,lat1,lon2,lat2. Overrides city and point search.
bbox.title: Map area

cities.description: Optional additional cities. Every search term runs in every city (mode=search).
cities.title: More cities

cityIds.description: Optional exact 2GIS city IDs. Use instead of city names when you already know the ID.
cityIds.title: City IDs

country.description: 2GIS country site. Leave on Auto-detect to derive it from the city or link.
country.title: Country site

districtIds.description: Optional district IDs. Useful for splitting a large city into smaller searches.
districtIds.title: District IDs

filter24x7.description: Only return places open around the clock.
filter24x7.title: Open 24/7 only

filterCardPayment.description: Only return places whose attributes mention card payment.
filterCardPayment.title: Card payment only

filterDelivery.description: Only return places whose published attributes mention delivery.
filterDelivery.title: Delivery only

filterHasGoods.description: Only return places that published goods or a menu.
filterHasGoods.title: Has goods/menu only

filterHasPhotos.description: Only return places that have photos on 2GIS.
filterHasPhotos.title: Has photos only

filterHasRating.description: Only return places with a rating.
filterHasRating.title: Has rating only

filterOpenNow.description: Only return places open at the time of the run.
filterOpenNow.title: Open now only

filterTakeaway.description: Only return places whose attributes mention takeaway or pickup.
filterTakeaway.title: Takeaway only

filterWifi.description: Only return places whose attributes mention Wi-Fi.
filterWifi.title: Wi-Fi only

includeContacts.description: Add phones, websites, emails, social links and messengers.
includeContacts.title: Include contacts

includePhotos.description: Add photo URLs when 2GIS exposes them. A main photo URL and photo count are included whenever available.
includePhotos.title: Include photo URLs

includeReviews.description: Add review texts to each place when 2GIS exposes them. Rating and review counts are always included.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

language.description: Language of names and content returned by 2GIS. Auto uses the country site's default.
language.title: Language

latitude.description: Center latitude for an area search (mode=search). Set together with longitude; overrides the city center.
latitude.title: Latitude

locationQuery.description: City or area to search in (mode=search), for example Moscow, Алматы or Dubai. Can be a local or English name.
locationQuery.title: City

longitude.description: Center longitude for an area search (mode=search). Set together with latitude.
longitude.title: Longitude

maxAverageCheck.description: Keep only places whose published average check is at most this value, in local currency.
maxAverageCheck.title: Maximum average check

maxItems.description: Maximum number of places per search term + city/area combination.
maxItems.title: Max places

maxPhotosPerPlace.description: Maximum photo URLs per place when photos are enabled (1–100).
maxPhotosPerPlace.title: Max photos per place

maxReviewsPerPlace.description: Maximum review texts per place when reviews are enabled (1–1000).
maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max reviews per place

minAverageCheck.description: Keep only places whose published average check is at least this value, in local currency.
minAverageCheck.title: Minimum average check

minRating.description: Keep only places rated at least this value (0–5).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Keep only places with at least this many reviews.
minReviews.title: Minimum reviews

mode.description: What to read: search the directory, expand 2GIS links, or look up place IDs.
mode.title: Mode

radiusMeters.description: Search radius around latitude/longitude, in meters (1–50000).
radiusMeters.title: Radius (meters)

reviewsKeyword.description: Keep only reviews whose text contains this word or phrase.
reviewsKeyword.title: Review keyword

reviewsMinRating.description: Keep only reviews with at least this star rating (1–5).
reviewsMinRating.title: Minimum review rating

reviewsSince.description: Keep only reviews created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
reviewsSince.title: Reviews since

reviewsWithAnswer.description: Keep only reviews that have an official business reply.
reviewsWithAnswer.title: Reviews with a business reply

rubricIds.description: Only places in these 2GIS categories (rubric IDs), for example 162 for coffee shops.
rubricIds.title: Category IDs

scrapeOrgBranches.description: When a place link is given, also return the other branches of the same organization.
scrapeOrgBranches.title: Expand organization branches

searchQueries.description: What to look for, one term per line (mode=search). Example: coffee, restaurant, стоматология. Use the local language for better coverage.
searchQueries.title: Search terms

sortBy.description: Order of search results. Distance needs a latitude/longitude or map area.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Search, place (/firm/), organization (/branches/) or building (/inside/) links, go.2gis.com short links, or bare place IDs (mode=urls).
startUrls.title: 2GIS links

websiteFilter.description: Return all places, only places with a website, or only places without one.
websiteFilter.title: Website

title: 2GIS Business Directory Input
